https://telex.hu/belfold/2026/08/29/tisz.text: Menü Kereső Leállt a tiszalöki erőmű áramtermelése az alacsony vízállás miatt Belföld Fotó: Sztraka Ferenc Nyilas Gergely Állítsd be a Telexet megbízható forrásnak! Beállítom A Tiszalöki Vízerőmű áramtermelésének leállásáról számolt be a térség tiszás parlamenti képviselője. „A Tisza rendkívül alacsony vízállása miatt leállították a Tiszalöki Vízerőművet. Fontos hangsúlyozni, hogy az erőmű elsődleges feladata a vízhozam szabályozás, az energiatermelés csak másodlagos funkciója. Tiszalök és a térség energiaellátása továbbra is biztosított, miközben a Paksi Atomerőmű teljes kapacitással termel” – írta Facebook-bejegyzésében Szakács Péter Lajos. Az erőmű áramtermelési kapacitása üzemszerű körülmények között 12,9 megawatt – ez 0,65 százaléka a Paksi Atomerőmű teljes kapacitásának –, de a folyó alacsony vízállása miatt ezt már a legutóbbi időszakban egyébként sem érte el. Az objektum elsődleges feladata nem is az áramtermelés, hanem a víz szabályozása, amit most a duzzasztó egyetlen működésben tartott zsilipjével látnak el. Mivel az év során a szokásos vízmennyiség negyedét hozta a Tisza vízgyűjtő területe, a folyón lejjebb lévő – a Kiskörei Erőmű megépítésével mesterségesen létrehozott – Tisza-tó hasznosítható víztartaléka lényegében elfogyott, miután szintje 610 centiméterre csökkent. „Tegnap megkezdődött a Tiszalöki Vízlépcső – a lehető legtöbb víz megtartása érdekében korábban maximálisra emelt – felvizének csökkentése, amelynek eredményeként többlet vízhozam vezethető át a Tisza-tó, a Keleti-főcsatorna és a Körös-völgy irányába” – közölte szombaton az Észak-magyarországi Vízügyi Igazgatóság (ÉMVIZIG) a Facebookon. Víz áteresztése Tiszalöknél egyetlen zsilipen keresztül a folyó alsó szakaszára – Fotó: Rokonál Zoltán / Időkép Ennélfogva a tervek szerint a következő hét során a Tiszalöknél tartott 420 centiméteres vízszíntből 20 centimétert leengednek, ezzel juttatva némi többlethez a folyó alsóbb szakaszait. Kérdéseinkkel az ÉMVIZIG-hez fordultunk, az igazgatóság megerősítette a Telexnek, hogy átvették a vízkormányzást az MVM Tiszalöki Erőműtől a vízhiányos helyzet miatt. „A 3-as számú billenőtáblán keresztül vizet engedünk át – a korábban a lehető legtöbb víz megtartása érdekében maximálisra emelt – felvízről az alvízre a Tisza-tó irányába, ugyanakkor a korábban betározott vízkészletből áramlik víz a Keleti-főcsatornába is” – közölték. A felvíz szintje jelenleg 409 centiméter, tehát még 9 centit engednek le belőle. Kedvenceink Partnereinktől Állítsd be a Telexet megbízható forrásnak! Beállítom Kövess minket Facebookon is! Követem! Photograph: Justin Sullivan/Getty Images Tesla Tesla beats earnings projections after Musk floats SpaceX merger plan Musk says ‘there’s a lot of merit’ to potential merger that would require approval of 50% of all Tesla shareholders, but he declined to elaborate Dara Kerr Wed 21 Oct 2026 19.03 EDT First published on Wed 21 Oct 2026 15.41 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Investors were paying close attention to Tesla’s third-quarter earnings call on Wednesday afternoon, after chief executive Elon Musk floated the idea of merging the car company with his rocket and AI company, SpaceX. But they didn’t glean further information after the company announced there would be no questions on the matter. “With regard to a potential merger with SpaceX , I think I said everything that should be said yesterday,” Musk, the CEO of both companies, said on Tesla’s earnings call. He repeated a phrase he said on Tuesday: “I feel like I’m tap dancing through a minefield.” On a call with SpaceX investors on Tuesday, Musk said it would be a “good idea” to combine the two companies and that “there’s a lot of merit” that would come with it. Musk said on Tuesday that the board of directors for both of his businesses had put together special committees to explore the potential merger, but had not yet reached an agreement on the terms of the transaction. The move would require the approval of 50% of all Tesla shareholders. Tesla and SpaceX explore merger as Elon Musk gives backing Read more On Wednesday, Tesla reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings, with a reported revenue of $28.05bn and $0.48 on earnings per share. That beat Wall Street’s projections of $27.9bn in revenue, with $0.43 on earnings per share. Still, the company came in at a slightly lower revenue than last quarter , which was $28.23bn. And its automotive revenue dropped 3% from the year prior. “We maintained strong momentum on many projects spanning Super Intelligence (SI), robotics and renewable energy that will be critical to building a future of Amazing Abundance,” the company wrote in its report . Despite the stronger-than-anticipated quarter, Tesla has experienced a rough year with falling stock and increased competition from cheaper Chinese automakers. The company’s share price has fallen by more than 11% this year, although it appears to have rebounded some since last week with the news of the possible SpaceX merger. Last week, Musk unveiled the company’s electric sports car , the Roadster 2, which he said uses technology from SpaceX to “basically fly like a rocket”. At a demonstration at a SpaceX facility in Texas, a remote-controlled version of the car drove up a steeply curved ramp and then used jet-like thrusters to flip over, hover and land. The vehicle is priced at upwards of $200,000. “Flying cars are real … It can basically fly like a rocket, it can do rolls, crazy gymnastics,” Musk said at the event, adding: “I’m not sure it’s necessarily legal in all jurisdictions.” During Tesla’s earnings call on Wednesday, he added that the event was “the coolest demo of any product ever”. skip past newsletter promotion Free newsletter | Weekly Sign up to TechScape A weekly dive in to how technology is shaping our lives after newsletter promotion Tesla’s vehicle sales are not as crucial to its market performance as they once were, as the company has pivoted towards robotics, autonomous driving and AI. Tesla’s Optimus robot has faced production hurdles, however; and its driverless taxi service, Robotaxi, has hit road blocks in scaling its fleet and expanding to new cities. “Tesla’s leaders continue to make big claims about autonomous mobility and physical AI. The company has achieved remarkable things but continues to miss some of its leaders’ bolder bets,” said Paul Miller, a principal analyst for market research firm Forrester. “Tesla robotaxis are undeniably carrying passengers, but not yet at anywhere near the levels the company promised.” Musk has long declared the Robotaxi will have near-infinite demand and that “probably half the population of the US” would be using the autonomous ride-hailing service by the end of 2025. Similarly, the CEO has forecast the manufacture of as many as 1m Optimus robots each year. As Miller pointed out with Musk’s promises, he has failed to reach those lofty targets and rollout has been slow. Musk once again touted the robots on Wednesday, saying: “I remain convinced that Optimus will be the biggest product on earth and humanoid robots in general will be the biggest product on earth.” He added that no other company compares to Tesla in developing humanoid robots – this is despite Chinese competitors making vast strides in the technology. Posts By Ayyoun Ali How to Upgrade/Polish Accessories in Phantom Blade Zero To polish or upgrade accessories in Phantom Blade Zero, players will need to complete the Crimson Forest (second region) and arrive in the Village of Lu (third region). After waking up at the Place of Awakening bell, you'll need to follow the trail until you automatically encounter an NPC named " Jewel ." Don't forget to ask her "About the faint weeping" to progress the "Whence the Weeping" quest . Selecting the option "Polish Accessories" will open up the accessory upgrade tab . If you have enough Tainted Crystal Shards or Refined Indigo Crystal, you'll be able to upgrade your accessories one or even multiple times depending on the type of accessory. After encountering Jewel, you'll now be able to access the accessory upgrade menu straight from any bell. Just head into the "Upgrade Equipment" tab and switch the tab over to accessories. Upgrading your accessory will significantly boost its stats. However, you'll need to think about it carefully before upgrading, as materials spent on polishing accessories aren't refundable , unlike weapons. If you're short of Tainted Crystal Shards or Refined Indigo Crystal to polish accessories in Phantom Blade Zero , you can acquire them by two main methods. Purchase them from the shop at any bell. The more Quick Hand Zhang hideouts you discover , the more materials are available to purchase here. Find them by opening chests, especially the cracked wooden ones that give off a light-blue hue.
